description: Run the HeroX OPEX calculator: annual and monthly costs for fan/inflation, heating, cooling and lighting. Length, width and target temperature are always given in ft and °F (the page's slider values); unit_system only switches the page to metric display (€, m, °C) and its metric formula variant, exactly like the page. This is an estimate for planning purposes only, not a quote.

climate.description: Climate: hot = Hot (Dubai, UAE); mild = Mild (Brussels, Belgium); cold = Cold (New York, NY); veryCold = Very Cold (Columbus, OH); extremelyCold = Extremely Cold (Montreal, Canada).

electricity_price_per_kwh.description: Electricity Price in $/kWh (€/kWh in metric), e.g. 0.3745. The page field shows this ×100 (37.45).

energy_efficiency.description: Energy Efficiency (membrane): standard = Standard U 3.05 / R 2; hero = Hero U 1.74 / R 3; superhero = Superhero U 1.43 / R 4; insulated = Insulated U 0.57 / R 10; apex = Apex U 0.42 / R 14.

gas_price_per_kwh.description: Gas Price in $/kWh (€/kWh in metric), e.g. 0.1147. The page field shows this ×100 (11.47).

length_ft.description: Length in feet (50-400, page slider step 10).

operational_mode.description: Operational Mode: seasonal = 180 days/year, permanent = 365 days/year.

unit_system.description: Unit System. imperial = $ / ft / °F, metric = € / m / °C display.

width_ft.description: Width in feet (50-400, page slider step 10).

name: estimate_dome_opex
title: Estimate air dome operating costs
